question: What do we call a very big and strong plant? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! Trees are tall, big, and have strong woody trunks! 🌳
hint: Think of a mango or banyan plant.

question: What is the thick, brown stem of a tree called? 🪵
explanation: Great job! The thick brown part that holds the tree up is the trunk! 🪵
hint: Elephants also have something with this name!

question: Which of these is a huge tree? 🌳
explanation: Super! The Banyan is a massive tree with roots hanging from its branches! 🌳
hint: It is the National Tree of India.

question: What is the outside covering of a tree trunk called? 🪵
explanation: Fantastic! The rough outer layer that protects the tree is the bark! 🪵
hint: Dogs make a sound that has the same name!

question: What does a big tree give us on a hot, sunny day? ☀️
explanation: Wonderful! The wide branches of a tree block the sun and give us cool shade! 🌳
hint: It is a cool, dark spot under the leaves.

question: Which plant is short, bushy, and has hard stems? 🪴
explanation: Awesome! Shrubs are medium-sized plants that look like little bushes! 🪴
hint: A rose plant is an example.

question: Which of these is a famous shrub? 🌹
explanation: Great job! A rose plant is a beautiful shrub with hard, woody stems! 🌹
hint: It has beautiful red flowers and thorns.

question: How do the stems of a shrub feel? 🪵
explanation: Super! Shrubs have stems that are woody and hard, but not as thick as a tree! 🪵
hint: They are woody but thin.

question: How tall is a shrub usually? 📏
explanation: Fantastic! Shrubs are not too tall and not too short, just medium! 🧍
hint: They are about as tall as you or slightly taller.

question: Which beautiful flower grows on a shrub? 🌺
explanation: Wonderful! The bright and pretty hibiscus flower grows on a bushy shrub! 🌺
hint: It has large red or pink petals.

question: What do we call very small plants with soft, green stems? 🌿
explanation: Great job! Herbs are tiny plants with very soft and green stems! 🌿
hint: Mint and coriander are examples.

question: Which of these is a fresh-smelling herb? 🍃
explanation: Super! Mint is a small herb that smells very fresh and cool! 🌿
hint: We use it to make green chutney.

question: What color is the stem of an herb? 🟢
explanation: Awesome! Herbs have soft stems that are completely green! 🟢
hint: It matches the color of the leaves.

question: Which herb is often found in our kitchen? 🍲
explanation: Fantastic! Coriander is a tasty herb we use to decorate and flavor our food! 🌿
hint: It is also known as Dhania.

question: Tulsi is an example of a small what? 🪴
explanation: Wonderful! Tulsi is a very special herb with soft green leaves and stems! 🌿
hint: It is often grown in the courtyard of homes.

question: Which plant grows by crawling along the ground? 🍉
explanation: Super! Creepers spread and grow along the ground because their fruits are heavy! 🍉
hint: Pumpkins and watermelons grow on these.

question: Which plant needs a stick or wall to grow upwards? 🪜
explanation: Awesome! Climbers have weak stems and need support to climb up high! 🧗
hint: Like someone climbing a ladder.

question: A pumpkin grows on which type of plant? 🎃
explanation: Great job! A pumpkin is too heavy, so its plant creeps along the ground! 🎃
hint: It stays on the floor of the garden.

question: What kind of plant is a Money Plant? 🌿
explanation: Fantastic! Money plants climb up walls or sticks using their twisting stems! 🌿
hint: It goes up and up with some support.

question: Why do creepers stay on the ground? 🍉
explanation: Wonderful! Creepers grow big, heavy fruits like watermelons, so they stay low! 🍉
hint: Think about how big a watermelon is.

question: What is the color of most healthy leaves? 🍃
explanation: Awesome! Leaves are mostly green because of a magic color called chlorophyll! 🍃
hint: The color of grass.

question: What happens to old leaves in autumn? 🍂
explanation: Great job! Old leaves turn yellow or brown and fall down to the ground! 🍂
hint: They drop from the branches.

question: Which of these leaves do we eat as food? 🥬
explanation: Super! Spinach is a yummy, healthy leaf that makes us strong! 🥬
hint: Popeye loves eating this!

question: What special job do leaves do for the plant? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! Leaves use sunlight to cook tasty food for the whole plant! 🥗
hint: They are like the kitchen of the plant.

question: Which plant has very long and huge leaves? 🍌
explanation: Wonderful! Banana leaves are so big that people sometimes eat food on them! 🍌
hint: Monkeys love the fruit of this plant.

question: If you rub a lemon leaf, what will you notice? 🍋
explanation: Awesome! Many leaves have special smells, and lemon leaves smell fresh and sour! 🍋
hint: Use your nose to find out.

question: What is the shape of a pine tree leaf? 🌲
explanation: Great job! Pine leaves are long, thin, and sharp, just like sewing needles! 🌲
hint: It is thin and sharp.

question: What are the tiny lines we see on a leaf called? 🍃
explanation: Super! Veins are tiny tubes that carry water all over the leaf! 🕸️
hint: Look closely at the back of a leaf.

question: How do Neem leaves taste? 🌿
explanation: Fantastic! Neem leaves taste bitter, but they are very healthy and keep bugs away! 🌿
hint: It is the opposite of sweet.

question: What color are dry, crunchy fallen leaves? 🍂
explanation: Wonderful! When leaves dry up, they lose their green color and turn brown! 🍂
hint: Think of the crunchy leaves in a park.

question: Which insect has bright, colorful wings? 🦋
explanation: Awesome! Butterflies flutter around gardens showing off their beautiful colored wings! 🦋
hint: It starts as a caterpillar.

question: Which tiny insect always walks in a straight line? 🐜
explanation: Great job! Ants are great teammates and always follow each other in a line! 🐜
hint: They love sugar.

question: Which green insect hops high in the grass? 🦗
explanation: Super! Grasshoppers have strong back legs to jump super high in the grass! 🦗
hint: Its name has 'grass' in it!

question: Which buzzy insect makes sweet honey? 🐝
explanation: Fantastic! Honeybees collect nectar from flowers to make yummy, sweet honey! 🐝
hint: It says buzzzz.

question: What soft, wiggly creature hides inside garden soil? 🪱
explanation: Wonderful! Earthworms wiggle through the mud and are great friends to farmers! 🪱
hint: You often see them after it rains.

question: Where do butterflies love to sit in a garden? 🌸
explanation: Awesome! Butterflies sit on colorful flowers to drink sweet nectar! 🌸
hint: They love colorful, sweet-smelling things.

question: Which insect has a hard, shiny shell like armor? 🪲
explanation: Great job! Beetles have hard wing cases that protect them like a helmet! 🪲
hint: It crawls and looks very shiny.

question: What does a Ladybug look like? 🐞
explanation: Super! Ladybugs are bright red with cute little black polka dots! 🐞
hint: It is round, red, and spotted.

question: Which small creature spins a silky web? 🕷️
explanation: Fantastic! Spiders weave amazing sticky webs to catch their food! 🕷️
hint: It has eight legs.

question: Which insect on a trail has lots and lots of tiny legs? 🐛
explanation: Wonderful! Millipedes are long bugs that walk on dozens of tiny little legs! 🐛
hint: Its name means 'thousand feet'.

question: What smells very sweet when we walk in nature? 🌸
explanation: Awesome! Beautiful blooming flowers fill the air with a sweet, lovely perfume! 🌸
hint: Bees love visiting these.

question: What wonderful sound can you hear in the trees? 🐦
explanation: Great job! Nature trails are full of chirping, singing birds hiding in the leaves! 🐦
hint: Tweet tweet!

question: How does an old tree trunk feel if you touch it? 🪵
explanation: Super! The bark of big old trees feels very bumpy, crackly, and rough! 🪵
hint: It is the opposite of smooth.

question: What feels nice and tickly to walk on barefoot? 🌾
explanation: Fantastic! Cool, soft grass feels wonderful and tickly on our bare feet! 🌾
hint: It is green and covers the ground in parks.

question: What do we breathe in during a morning nature walk? 🌬️
explanation: Wonderful! Plants give out clean, fresh air that keeps us healthy and active! 🌬️
hint: It feels cool and clean in your lungs.

question: What floating shapes can we see in the sky on a walk? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! Looking up, we see soft, white fluffy clouds moving in the sky! ☁️
hint: They look like floating cotton candy.

question: What is the best thing to do on a nature trail? 🚶
explanation: Great job! Walking quietly helps us see tiny bugs and hear shy birds! 👀
hint: Use your eyes and ears gently.

question: How do water drops on morning grass feel? 💧
explanation: Super! Morning dew drops make the green grass feel wonderfully wet and cool! 💧
hint: They look like tiny diamonds on the leaves.

question: What might you find hiding under a small rock? 🪲
explanation: Fantastic! Tiny bugs and earthworms love resting under cool, damp rocks! 🪲
hint: They are very small and crawl away fast.

question: How can we learn secrets on a nature walk? 🧐
explanation: Wonderful! By opening our eyes and looking closely, nature shows us amazing things! 👀
hint: Use the magical power of observation!
